title: Furniture Workshop Automation
tagline: Orders, quotes, stock and purchasing for a made-to-order furniture workshop, automated end to end.
summary: An automation system built on n8n and Supabase (Postgres) that turns emails, forms and showroom tablets into priced orders.

paragraphs: Full case study coming in Task 7.

sections.alt: Input channels feed n8n workflows, which call SQL functions in Supabase; notifications leave through outbox queues to Slack and Gmail.
